faqs.question: What does a template purchase include?
faqs.answer: A template purchase includes full source code, asset files, documentation, and installation guides with your selected license.

faqs.question: Can templates be customized for my company?
faqs.answer: Yes! The source code is 100% editable. You can customize branding, routes, and features yourself or contract our engineering team.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom web and CRM software development?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide end-to-end bespoke digital engineering for healthcare, education, resorts, real estate, and enterprise CRM.

faqs.question: What is the refund and support policy?
faqs.answer: We provide technical support for all licensed products and evaluate refund requests on verified technical issues.
